blocks.note: Choose a sound French -ment form or an idiomatic adverbial phrase instead of translating English -ly mechanically.
Retrieve fixed adjective-as-adverb combinations and keep the adverbial form invariable.
Select degree adverbs by their scope and distinguish concrete au moins from speaker-oriented du moins.
Form regular and irregular adverbial comparatives and superlatives, including mieux and le mieux.
Determine the grammatical role of tout before choosing its agreeing or invariable form.
Choose time adverbs by event structure and by whether the reference point is speech time or a narrated time.
Distinguish place adverbs from linking and speaker-oriented sentence adverbs in context.
Repair adverb placement and recognize formal inversion after selected sentence-initial adverbs.
